text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "Technical and economic deliberations are incorporated into the process.", "severity": 0.6, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "Interested parties have the opportunity to submit comments and statements of position within the scope of the consultation and participation procedure.", "severity": 0.6, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "The sectoral planning procedure is implemented in several stages.", "severity": 0.6, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "The entity submitting the application (as a rule, national grid operator Swissgrid AG) draws up potential planning zone variants and concludes a cooperation agreement with the involved cantons.", "severity": 0.8, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Ce document fixe les objectifs du projet, les compétences et le calendrier des étapes suivantes, la participation et l’information des communes ainsi que la procédure d’adaptation de la planification cantonale.", "severity": 1, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Cette façon de procéder permet d’assurer que les requêtes des cantons soient prises en compte le plus tôt possible dans la planification.", "severity": 0.8, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "L’entreprise requérante demande ensuite à l’Office fédéral de l’énergie (OFEN) de mener une procédure de plan sectoriel.", "severity": 0.8, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Elle joint à sa demande une justification du projet et des informations sur sa nécessité ainsi qu’une évaluation des zones de planification possibles et l’accord de coordination.", "severity": 0.8, "before": ""}]}
